author: Googleov korisnik
developer_reply: Damir, you have misunderstood how CSV (Comma Separated Values) files work. They split by comma and work with all languages. Next, dates are in unix time. There are many timezones around the world so computers use a timezone called UCT and unix time. You can convert unix time to your local timezone. If you need help, email me. Cheers, Steve
